960	You have to understand what the smell was like in the morning, and how the whole house had to be disinfected in the morning, and how everyone gets organized in the morning,	É preciso entender como era o cheiro de manhã, e como a casa toda tinha de ser desinfetada de manhã, e como todos se organizam de manhã,
961	each one for his own learning, and Mother conducting it all, while she herself	cada um para o seu estudo, e a mamãe regendo tudo, enquanto ela mesma
962	is also a kindergarten teacher, and also has to be at work.	também é professora de jardim de infância, e também precisa estar no trabalho.
963	So it came to pass one day that one of the children arrived at kindergarten with shoes that were two	Então um dia, um dos filhos chegou ao jardim de infância com sapatos que eram dois
964	odd ones.	pés diferentes.
965	When Father noticed, while he was at home, that here were two odd shoes, he understood the child had gone with two	Quando o papai percebeu, estando em casa, que ali havia dois sapatos diferentes, entendeu que o filho tinha ido com dois
966	odd ones.	diferentes.
967	He went to the trouble and made a fuss and replaced the shoes for him.	Deu-se ao trabalho, correu atrás e trocou-lhe os sapatos.
968	So that he wouldn't have two odd ones, but a pair.	Para que ele não tivesse dois diferentes, mas um par.
969	He took the trouble and made the effort; his eye is watching, his eye is learning Gemara, in holy	Ele se esforçou e se empenhou; seu olhar vigia, seu olhar estuda Guemará, em sagradas
970	unifications, but also on the shoes and the order of the children.	unificações, mas também nos sapatos e na ordem dos filhos.
971	In our house all the shoes stood like soldiers; there was no such thing as scattered shoes,	Em nossa casa todos os sapatos ficavam alinhados como soldados; não existia sapato espalhado,
972	no such things, clothes thrown around; never in our lives was there such a thing.	nada disso, roupas jogadas; nunca na vida houve uma coisa dessas.
973	No garment was ever thrown; everything was organized, in order, even the laundry, everything taken care of.	Nenhuma roupa ficava jogada; tudo era organizado, em ordem, até a roupa lavada, tudo cuidado.
974	Father and Mother were orderly, so Father noticed a scattered shoe, not	Papai e mamãe eram organizados, então papai reparou num sapato espalhado, fora de
975	in order, two odd ones, and he went and changed the shoes for him.	ordem, dois diferentes, e foi trocar os sapatos dele.
976	One of the girls once forgot to take food from home for the break.	Uma das meninas uma vez esqueceu de levar comida de casa para o recreio.
977	Suddenly Father arrived at the school with full bags of fruit and food.	De repente papai chegou à escola com sacolas cheias de frutas e comida.
978	You forgot to take a meal, you forgot to take fruit.	Você esqueceu de levar uma refeição, esqueceu de levar frutas.
979	When the children studied in yeshivot, yeshivot even outside the city,	Quando os filhos estudavam em yeshivot, mesmo fora da cidade,
980	Father would accompany them to the buses, sometimes get on the bus with them, sit with them inside	papai os acompanhava até os ônibus, às vezes entrava com eles no ônibus, sentava-se com eles lá dentro
981	until the driver started the engine and actually set off; then Father would get off, waving his hands	até o motorista ligar o motor e de fato partir; então papai descia, acenando com as mãos
982	outside, waiting until the children passed and disappeared from his sight, and only then would he return	do lado de fora, esperando até os filhos passarem e sumirem de sua vista, e só depois voltava
983	home.	para casa.
984	Accompanying them to yeshivah, accompanying them to the bus.	Acompanhar à yeshivá, acompanhar ao ônibus.
985	When I was a young man and studied at a yeshivah in Beit Vegan in Jerusalem,	Quando eu era rapaz e estudei numa yeshivá em Beit Vegan, em Jerusalém,
986	I studied then at Yeshivat Or Baruch of Rav Toledano, of blessed memory, Rav	estudei então na Yeshivat Or Baruch do Rav Toledano, de abençoada memória, Rav
987	Michael, Rav Gabriel, Rav Omer, of blessed memory.	Michael, Rav Gabriel, Rav Omer, de abençoada memória.
988	When I studied there at the yeshivah, Father and Mother came and took me on the first day,	Quando estudei lá na yeshivá, papai e mamãe vieram me levar no primeiro dia,
989	sat with me, and didn't budge until they saw that the bed was made there in the dormitory and that everything	sentaram comigo e não saíram até verem que a cama estava arrumada ali no internato e que tudo
990	and that I was settled; and they would come to visit me and bring me trays of things.	e que eu estava acomodado; e vinham me visitar e traziam bandejas de comidas.
991	What responsibility, what warmth, what love, what	Quanta responsabilidade, quanto calor, quanto amor, quanto
992	caring. My brother Rav Shmuel tells	cuidado. Meu irmão, Rav Shmuel, conta
993	that when he would go to yeshivah and come back at night to sleep, our father would arrive	que quando ele ia para a yeshivá e voltava à noite para dormir, nosso pai chegava
994	in the night hours, would go to Rav Shmuel's bed, stroke his face,	pelas horas da noite, ia até a cama do Rav Shmuel, acariciava o rosto dele,
995	and put five new shekels there and say to him: this is pocket money, buy yourself something with it.	e colocava ali cinco novos shekels e dizia: isto é mesada, compre algo com isso.
996	My brother Rav Shmuel received an embrace, received five shekels. I	Meu irmão, Rav Shmuel, recebeu um abraço, recebeu cinco shekels. Eu
997	remember that before there were shekels, I received from my father six lirot as pocket	lembro que, antes de haver shekels, recebi do meu pai seis liras de mesada,
998	money, lirot, which were the currency in the time of school,	liras, que eram a moeda no tempo da escola,
999	weekly pocket money.	mesada semanal.
